svg.aria-label: danieldias.dev. Live, you're here. I build and run this site. A local tool turns a draft into five language editions and validates each one before it opens a pull request. CI audits the dependencies, and the metrics endpoint sits behind a token. .NET, Razor Pages, Markdown, Docker. Source private. Copilot, AI: Dani Bot is part of this site too: an AI copilot that researches with me, reviews what I write and translates it.
